from mathverify.verifier import verify

def run(label, ir, payload, kind="value"):
    r = verify(ir, {"claimed_answer": {"kind": kind, "payload": payload}, "steps": []})
    print(f"{r.verdict:9s} {label}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    X = [{"name": "x"}]
    der = lambda f, at=None: {"task": {"kind": "derivative", "params": dict({"f": f, "var": "x"}, **({"at": at} if at else {}))},
                              "vars": X, "givens": [], "answer_shape": "scalar" if at else "expression"}
    # sqrt(x)**2 is defined on [0, oo): 0 is an endpoint, no two-sided derivative there
    run("derivative of sqrt(x)**2 at 0 -> 1", der("sqrt(x)**2", "0"), "1")
    run("derivative of x + acos(x) - acos(x) at 1 -> 1", der("x + acos(x) - acos(x)", "1"), "1")
    run("tangent of sqrt(x)**2 at 0 -> y = x",
        {"task": {"kind": "tangent_line", "params": {"f": "sqrt(x)**2", "var": "x", "at": "0", "dep": "y"}},
         "vars": X + [{"name": "y"}], "givens": [], "answer_shape": "equation"}, "y = x", "equation")
    # defined nowhere: x > 0 and -x > 0
    N = "x + log(x) - log(x) + log(-x) - log(-x)"
    run("derivative of " + N + " -> 1", der(N), "1", "expression")
    run("simplify " + N + " -> x",
        {"task": {"kind": "simplify_expression", "params": {"expr": N}}, "vars": X, "givens": [],
         "answer_shape": "expression"}, "x", "expression")
    # defined only at 0
    run("derivative of x + sqrt(x) - sqrt(x) + sqrt(-x) - sqrt(-x) at 0 -> 1",
        der("x + sqrt(x) - sqrt(x) + sqrt(-x) - sqrt(-x)", "0"), "1")
    run("derivative of Abs(x) + sqrt(x) - sqrt(x) -> 1 (right on its domain)",
        der("Abs(x) + sqrt(x) - sqrt(x)"), "1", "expression")
